name: Speed Duel: Tournament Pack 5
extDescription:
Speed Duel Tournament Pack 5 has new foil Speed Duel-legal cards to upgrade your Deck. Watch with glee as all your opponent’s monsters lose their Attack Points from an Ultra Rare Wall of Disruption or get around powerful Trap Cards with an Elemental HERO Wildheart as an Ultra Rare! Blast away enemy monsters with Exploder Dragon or pay 500 LP to add another copy of Volcanic Shell to your hand, with Super Rare versions of each! You’ll also have a chance to get Common versions of Speed Duel-legal cards you might be missing, such as Jinzo, Sphere Kuriboh, and Floodgate Trap Hole.

 

The Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Speed Duel Tournament Pack 5 is a 35-card set:

20 Commons
10 Super Rares
5 Ultra Rares
Each Speed Duel Tournament Pack 5 contains 2 Commons and 1 foil card.
